'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Sherrington LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sherrington]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I Poop Your Cards
* '''Username:''' malix solosar
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
